wizard.resumeBody: Wari ugeze kuri {step}. Nta cyatakaye — komeza aho wari.

w1.title: {business} ikora iki?
w1.lede: Ibi bituma tuguha intangiriro isanzwe ikwiye — amasaha, ibibazo abakiriya babaza, n'amategeko y'ibanze. Byose urabihindura.

w2.title: Mufungura ryari?
w2.lede: Twabanje kuzuza amasaha asanzwe. Hindura ibitari byo.
w2.ah1d: Ibabwira amasaha n'aho muherereye, hanyuma igafata izina n'ikibazo.
w2.ah2: Isubize kandi ibafatire gahunda ku munsi ukurikira
w2.ah2d: Nka hejuru, ariko ishobora no gufata gahunda.
w2.ah3d: Nta gisubizo ku bibazo. Ikusanya amazina gusa.

w3.title: Mufata angahe?
w3.lede: Igiciro ni cyo abakiriya babaza kurusha ibindi byose. Iyo Subiza itagizi, ifata ubutumwa gusa.
w3.photoP: Ubucuruzi bwinshi bufite urupapuro rw'ibiciro rwanditse. Rufotore — ni byo byoroshye kuruta kwandika kuri telefone.
w3.onDevice: Ibi bikorerwa kuri telefone yawe. Nta data ikoreshwa mbere y'uko ifoto ikwiye.
w3.blurryP: Egera hafi gato, ufate telefone neza, kandi wirinde igicucu cyawe ku rupapuro.
w3.believe: Ibi ni byo Subiza yumva ko ari ibiciro byawe
w3.threeP: Iyindi yose twemeza. Iyi ntitwayumvise neza — kandi ntitugerageza gukeka igiciro.

w4.title: Igomba kumvikana ite?
w4.lede: Kanda ku buryo bwose wumve. Buri kimwe kivuga indamukanyo yawe nyayo, hamwe n'izina ry'ubucuruzi bwawe.
w4.silentP: Telefone yawe ishobora kuba iri mu buryo bw'akanyamuneza. Zamura ijwi hanyuma wongere ukande.
w4.clone: Cyangwa ukoreshe ijwi ryawe bwite — nyuma

w5.title: Ubu, umve ubwawe.
w5.lede: Subiza igiye kuvuza telefone yawe. Igire nk'aho uri umukiriya — uyibaze icyo ushaka cyose.
w5.ringing: Ivuza ubu. Iyo wumvise indamukanyo, baza ikibazo.
w5.hang: Umanura telefone urangije. Ibi byose birabikwa.
w5.missedP: Nta kibazo. Hari izindi nzira ebyiri, kandi imwe muri zo ikora nta telefone.
w5.q2: «Mufunguye ku cyumweru?» — uzumva ko izi ko mufunze
w5.q3: Ibaze ikintu utigeze uyibwira. Reba icyo ikora.
w5.neverRangP: Ntabwo aribwo buryo bwonyine bwo kugerageza. Hari ubundi bubiri.
w5.triedP: Umurongo ntiwakiriye guhamagara. Akenshi biterwa n'umurongo, si telefone yawe.
w5.dialP: Uhamagara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Umufasha wawe ni we uzakwakira.
w5.works: Ikora mu masaha 24 ari imbere. Nta mafaranga isaba.
w5.webP: Iki ni igerageza ryoroshye kuruta iry'ukuri. Bigerageza ibyo ivuga.
w5.micP: Dukeneye kwumva ijwi ryawe kugira ngo tugerageze.
w5.micNoP: Koresha izindi nzira ebyiri, zitagusaba na kimwe.
w5.outageP: Ni ikibazo cyacu, si icyawe, kandi ntaho gihuriye n'umufasha wawe.
w5.voicemailP: Twahagaritse kugira ngo ntitukoreshe amafaranga ku mashini.
w5.cannotFail: Iki kizamini ntikigomba kunanirana. Niba inzira zose zinaniranye, umuntu azaguhamagara.

w6.title: Ni iki cyakoze neza?
w6.lede: Soma ibyavuzwe. Ikosora rikora ako kanya — ntiryinjira mu murongo utegereje.
w6.fixH: Ibi bihindura amasaha yawe ako kanya, kandi bikandikwa mu nkoranyamagambo y'imvugo.

w7.title: Ikeneye umuntu, ihamagare nde?
w7.lede: Umufasha udashobora kuzana umuntu ntabwo twemera ko asubiza abakiriya. Ni yo mpamvu iyi ntambwe idasimburwa.
w7.hint: Iyi ni iyawe. Ushobora kuyihindura cyangwa ukongeraho abandi nyuma.
w7.refuseP: Subiza ikeneye umuntu yo guhamagara iyo itabashije gufasha. Nta nomero, ntishobora gusubiza abakiriya bawe.

w8.title: Huza telefone yawe
w8.lede: Ukomeza nomero yawe. Abakiriya bakomeza guhamagara iyo bamenyereye, kandi Subiza ifata gusa ibyo utabashije gufata.
w8.heading: Kanda iyi kode kuri telefone ifite SIM
w8.rings: Telefone yawe ivuza amasegonda 20 mbere, buri gihe.
w8.plat: Kuri Android gusa, kandi ntihamagara yonyine. Kuri iPhone hagaragara intambwe zo gukoporora no gushyiramo.
w8.checkedP: Twahamagaye nomero yawe, Subiza irafata nyuma y'amasegonda 20.
w8.sandboxP: Ntabwo asubiza abakiriya nyabo kugeza ubikoze, ariko urashobora kuvugana na we uko ushaka.

w9.title: Ikore kangahe?
w9.lede: Tangira ku gito. Uzayongerera ubushobozi wowe ubwawe, igihe uzaba wiziye.
w9.r1d: Guhamagara kose kw'amanywa kuza kuri wowe. Nijoro no ku cyumweru, isubiza.
w9.r2d: Telefone yawe ivuza mbere buri gihe. Subiza ifata nyuma y'amasegonda 20.
w9.r3d: Isubiza mbere buri gihe, ikaguhamagara iyo umukiriya akeneye umuntu.

home.title: Byarangiye. Umufasha wawe arasubiza.
home.lede: Ibisigaye ntabwo ari ngombwa, kandi nta na kimwe cyihutirwa. Dore aho ugeze.
home.waD: Meta isaba iminsi 5–15 — tangira uyu munsi
home.paused: Guhamagara bigeze kuri wowe. Umufasha yahagaritswe.

aside.w1ap: Urupapuro rwera ni yo mpamvu ya mbere abantu bareka. Intangiriro isanzwe ikwiye ni cyo kintu cyihuta.
aside.w1bp: Aya atandatu aratandukanye bihagije ku muntu ubireba mu masegonda abiri.
aside.w2ap: Ni ugusubiza saa tatu z'ijoro ku cyumweru. Ni yo mpamvu amasaha aza hano hakiri kare.
aside.w2bp: Ntitukubwira ko bizafata igihe kirekire. Uturanga twerekana aho uri, nta kubara hasi.
aside.w3ap: Igiciro ni umurongo w'ubwoko: gisomwa, nti gihangwa.
aside.w3bp: Ifoto isuzumwa kuri telefone yawe mbere y'uko byte biva aho.
aside.w4ap: Buri jwi rivuga indamukanyo yawe nyayo, hamwe n'izina ry'ubucuruzi bwawe.
aside.w4bp: Buri jwi rikinishwa gusa iyo ukanze.
aside.w5ap: Kwiyandikisha si ugukoresha. Ni ubwo umuntu yumvise umufasha we asubiza ikibazo ku bucuruzi bwe.
aside.w5b: Inzira eshatu, kuko iyi ntambwe idashobora kunanirwa
aside.w5bp: Turaguhamagara. Bitagenze, uvugana nayo muri navigateur. Bitagenze na none, uhamagara nomero.
aside.w6a: Aha ni ho igicuruzwa cyigisha uko gitekereza
aside.w6ap: Isubiza ibyo wamubwiye, urabona impamvu, urabikosora, kandi ikosora rikora ako kanya.
aside.w7ap: Umufasha udashobora kuzana umuntu ntabwo yagombye gusubiza umukiriya na rimwe.
aside.w8ap: Kode yo kohereza guhamagara ni itegeko riva kuri SIM yawe. Icyo dushobora ni ukuguhamagara tukakubwira ko yakoze.
aside.w8bp: Usimbutse, umufasha akomeza gukora mu buryo bwo kugerageza.
aside.w9ap: Turi kugusaba kwemera ko ifata guhamagara kudafatwa na n'umwe.
aside.w9bp: Ntabwo tuzagusaba kuyizamura. Ushobora kuyisubiza aho yari iri mu kanya gato.

phone.g22: Telefone yawe iracyavuga. Nomero yawe ntacyo ihinduka. Nta n'umwe watakaye.
phone.humanLine: Aline aguhamagara mu minota 15, Kuwa mbere kugeza Kuwa gatandatu, 08:00–19:00.
phone.s1lede: Buri gihe dusaba ubwa mbere. Ntacyo bihindura ku bakiriya bawe, kandi bitangira uyu munsi.
phone.pathAd: Abakiriya bawe bakomeza guhamagara nomero bazi. Subiza ifata gusa ibyo utabashije gufata.
phone.pathBd: Umurongo wihariye wa Subiza. Bisaba iminsi kuko ubuyobozi busaba impapuro z'ubucuruzi bwawe.
phone.s2title: Ni guhamagara kuhe Subiza igomba gufata?
phone.s2lede: Ibi bihuye n'icyo wahisemo mu gushyiraho. Ushobora kubihindura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
phone.scope1d: Ntitwitabye, telefone irimo indi, cyangwa idafunguye. Ni kode eshatu zikandwa zikurikirana — tuzakwereka uko bikorwa.
phone.scope2d: Kode imwe gusa. Iyo telefone yawe irimo indi cyangwa idafunguye, guhamagara kuzagera kuri voicemail yawe nk'ubusanzwe.
phone.scope3d: Telefone yawe ntizongera kuvuza na rimwe. Ibi ni bike bikorwa, ariko birahari.
phone.allWarnBody: Kohereza kose bivuze ko buri hamagara kijya kuri Subiza ako kanya. Ni impinduka y'ukugera kuri we. Kanda ##21# niba ushaka ko telefone yawe isubira kuvuga.
phone.s3title: Kanda iyi kode kuri telefone yawe
phone.s3lede: Ni telefone ifite SIM yonyine ishobora kubikora. Nta rubuga — n'urwacu rurimo — rushobora kuyohereza mu mwanya wawe.
phone.netUnknown: Umurongo ntiwagaragaye ku ntangiriro ya nomero
phone.netHow: Twabimenye ku ntangiriro ya nomero yawe
phone.netPick: Ni uwuhe murongo ufite iyi SIM?
phone.vmBody: Kuri buri buryo, umurongo ushobora kohereza ahantu hamwe gusa. Uyu munsi ni voicemail; nyuma y'iyi kode izaba Subiza. Kanda *#61# mbere niba ushaka kureba icyo ufite ubu.
phone.codeNote: Telefone yawe ivuza amasegonda 20 mbere, buri gihe. Nyuma yayo gusa ni bwo Subiza ifata.
phone.platAndroid: Kuri Android gusa, kandi ntiyihamagara yonyine.
phone.platIos: Kuri iPhone, amahuza ya tel: ananirwa nta nteguza — koresha intambwe eshatu.
phone.ios3: Yishyiremo uhame. Amahuza yo guhamagara ananirwa nta nteguza kuri iPhone.
phone.ex61: «Andika ahantu ho kohereza iyo ntitabye». 61 ni umubare mpuzamahanga w'ubwo buryo.
phone.exN: Nomero ya Subiza. Ni yo yonyine iri hano ireba wowe.
phone.ex11: «Ku mahamagara y'ijwi gusa». Tuyohereza kuko inyandiko z'operateri zikoresha. Ubuhanga bwemera kuyisimbuka n'inyenyeri ebyiri — iyo shusho iri ku paji ikurikira niba iyi yanze.
phone.ex20: Tegereza amasegonda 20 mbere yuko byoherezwa. Ubuhanga bwemera 5 kugeza 30. Twahisemo 20 kugira ngo kode igire ikintu kimwe gike cyo kwangwa.
phone.undoHere: Guhagarika nyuma: ##002# isibura byose. Ku buryo: ##61#, ##67#, ##62#.
phone.s4lede: Turahamagara nomero yawe ubu. Ntukitabe — reka ivuze, kugira ngo tubone aho guhamagara kugarukira.
phone.still: Igenzura rya nyuma rirasigaye ku mugaragaro. Umurongo w'ijwi ushobora gucika mu gihe cy'ihamagara — ni bisanzwe.
phone.retryWait: Igenzura rya mbere ntiribonye kohereza. Umurongo uhabwa amasegonda 60, hanyuma tureba inshuro imwe — ubwabyo.
phone.okBody: Guhamagara kwawe utafashe ubu kugera kuri Subiza. Nta kindi ukeneye gukora.
phone.ownerBody: Ni byo bigomba kuba: telefone yawe ivuza mbere. Ariko kugira ngo tugenzure, reka ivuze igihe gito.
phone.cliTitle: Birakora — ariko nomero y'uhamagara ntabwo iza
phone.cliBody: Subiza irasubiza neza. Ariko itabona nomero y'uhamagaye, bityo ntizamenya umukiriya wagarutse, kandi ntizashobora kukwandikira nomero ye.
phone.badBody: Twahamagaye, telefone yawe iravuza, ariko ntabwo yaje kuri Subiza. Ntabwo ari ikosa ryawe — kode zimwe na zimwe zinanirwa ku murongo.
phone.mmiBody: Ubu butumwa buva kuri telefone cyangwa ku murongo, ntabwo buva kuri twe, kandi ntibusobanura ko wanditse nabi. Hari uburyo bwinshi bwo kubikora.
phone.elseBody: Hari icyasubije kitari Subiza — akenshi voicemail y'operateri. Aline ashobora kugufasha, Kuwa mbere–Kuwa gatandatu, 08:00–19:00.
phone.incBody: Igisubizo nticyagarutse. Ni icyacu, si icy'operateri, kandi ntabwo ari impamvu yo guhindura kode. Aline ashobora kongera, cyangwa ukande Genzura ubu.
phone.g22Body: Guhamagara kwaragarutse mu masegonda atari 8. Bivuga ko kohereza kose kuri ho, kandi telefone yawe ntikivuga. Kanda ##21# ubu. Aline ahari 08:00–19:00, Kuwa mbere–Kuwa gatandatu.
phone.r1d: {code} — nta masegonda, nta buryo bw'ijwi. Imirongo imwe yemera iyi shusho gusa.
phone.r2d: Kanda *#61# — telefone yawe izakwereka niba hari ahantu isanzwe yohereza, akenshi voicemail.
phone.r3d: Kanda ##002# gusiba ibyoherezwa byose, hanyuma wongere ukande iyacu.
phone.r4d: Kuwa mbere–Kuwa gatandatu, 08:00–19:00. Tuguhamagara mu minota 15.
phone.r4ok: Aline afite inkuru yose. Ntuzongera gusobanura. Igihe ni Kuwa mbere–Kuwa gatandatu, 08:00–19:00.
phone.prepaidBody: Ni ihame ry'operateri, si ikibazo cya telefone yawe. Aline azaguhamagara — kandi nomero nshya ya Subiza ni yo isubizo rikunze gukoreshwa.
phone.s7lede: Dore ibiriho ubu, n'uko wabihagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
phone.offBody: Kode imwe isibura ibyoherezwa byose. Guhamagara kugaruka kuri telefone yawe ako kanya, kandi nomero yawe ntacyo ihinduka. Imwe imwe: ##61#, ##67#, ##62#.
phone.costBody: Ku mirongo isanzwe ya GSM, nyir'umurongo — ni wowe — ni we wishyura igice cyoherejwe. Ntitwaramenya igipimo nyacyo cya MTN na Airtel Rwanda, kandi ntituzagihimba. Tuzagishyira hano tugikimenye.
phone.weekBody: Kohereza guhamagara bibikwa ku murongo w'operateri, si kuri twe. Tuzahamagara nomero yawe rimwe mu cyumweru mu masaha y'amanywa, kandi tukubwire mbere y'umukiriya wawe.
phone.s8lede: Ntabwo ari twe tubitinza. Ubuyobozi busaba impapuro z'ubucuruzi mbere yuko nomero itangwa, kandi ntitwabeshya ngo ni ako kanya.
phone.tl1d: Icyemezo cya RDB, indangamuntu, aderesi — rimwe gusa
phone.tl2d: Aha ni ho hategerezwa. Ntabwo dushobora kuyihutisha.
phone.s8okp: Umufasha wawe arahari. Nomero ni yo yonyine itegerejwe. Nomero yawe isanzwe ntacyo ihinduka.
phone.lostLede: Ibi bikunze kubaho nyuma yo guhindura SIM, guhindura telefone, cyangwa operateri asubije umurongo. Nta cyo wakoze nabi.
phone.lostBannerP: Twabimenye mu igenzura risanzwe. Kuva none, guhamagara utafashe ntikugera kuri Subiza.
phone.lostFoot: Mu gihe cyose, guhamagara kwawe kugera kuri telefone yawe. Nta n'umwe watakaye.

phoneAside.s1a: Kuki dusaba kohereza aho guhindura nomero
phoneAside.s1ap: Nta kwimura nomero, nta mpapuro z'ubuyobozi, nta gutegereza, kandi ikarita zawe n'ikimenyetso cy'iduka bikomeza gukora. Icyakora hari impamvu ikomeye kurushaho.
phoneAside.s1bp: Kohereza ku mimerere bivuze ko buri guhamagara Subiza ifata ari, mu buryo bwemewe, guhamagara ubucuruzi bwari kubura. Ni cyo gipimo cy'agaciro — kandi kiva mu buryo bwo gushyiraho, si mu kubara.
phoneAside.s2ap: Kutitaba, umurongo urimo indi, na telefone idafunguye ni imimerere itatu itandukanye kuri operateri, kandi buri imwe ifite kode yayo.
phoneAside.s2bp: Ubuhanga bwemera 5 kugeza 30. Twahisemo 20 tukayigumaho, kuko buri kintu gishobora guhinduka mu kode ni ikindi gishobora gutuma umurongo uyanga.
phoneAside.s3ap: Nta API ihari yo gushyiraho kohereza guhamagara ku telefone ya GSM iyo ari yo yose. Ntabwo ari uko tutabikoze — ni uko bidashoboka.
phoneAside.s3b: Kuki gukoporora ari bwo buryo bwa mbere
phoneAside.s3bp: Kuri Android, ihuza rya tel: rifungura dialler ifite kode. Kuri iPhone, kode za MMI muri tel: zinanirwa nta nteguza. Bityo gukoporora ni bwo buryo bukora hose.
phoneAside.s3cp: Voicemail y'operateri ni yo koresha ubu buryo bumwe. Umurongo ushobora kohereza ahantu hamwe gusa kuri buri mimerere, bityo kwandika iyacu bisimbura iyabo mu ituze.
phoneAside.s4ap: Ibicuruzwa byose byo muri iki cyiciro dusuzumye bisaba umukiriya kwihamagarira ubwe kugira ngo agenzure. Twe turahamagara, tukareba aho bigarukira, tukakubwira.
phoneAside.s4bp: Kohereza ku kutitaba gukora gusa iyo telefone ivuze ikarangira. Ufashe, ntacyo tugenzuye — ni yo mpamvu «warafashe» kidasa n'ikosa.
phoneAside.s5ap: Byakoze. Warafashe. Ntibyoherejwe. Byoherejwe ariko nomero yatakaye. Ikindi cyasubije. Igenzura ryacu riracitse. Ibya nyuma ntibikwiriye kubeshya.
phoneAside.s5bp: «Invalid MMI code» ni ubutumwa bukunze kugaragara ku kode zanditse neza. Bituruka kuri telefone cyangwa ku murongo.
phoneAside.s6ap: Kode ngufi, hanyuma kureba ibiriho, hanyuma gusibura byose, hanyuma umuntu. Buri ntambwe ni ngufi kuruta iyayikurikira, kandi iya nyuma buri gihe ni umuntu.
phoneAside.s6bp: Amasezerano amwe y'imbere ntiyemera kohereza guhamagara na gato. Iyo ari byo, nomero nshya ya Subiza ni yo isubizo.
phoneAside.s7ap: Umuntu uzi uko yakuraho impinduka aremera kuyikora. Guhisha inzira yo gusohoka ntibyongera abaguma — byongera guhagarara.
phoneAside.s7b: Kubura kwabyo ni bwo bwoba bukomeye
phoneAside.s7bp: Ubucuruzi butekereza ko burinzwe kandi butarinzwe ni bwo bubi kuruta ubwo tutigeze tugenzura. Igenzura rya buri cyumweru ni ryo ryo gukingira.
phoneAside.s8ap: Gutanga nomero ni ubwa mudasobwa ariko bufatiwe ku isuzuma ry'ubuyobozi, kandi iryo ntabwo ari ako kanya muri kano karere.
phoneAside.s9ap: Duhamagara nomero yawe rimwe mu cyumweru mu masaha y'amanywa, tukareba aho guhamagara kugarukira. Ni yo nzira yonyine.
phoneAside.s9bp: Ntitwabiceceka. Ntitwanategereje ko umukiriya wawe abibona mbere yawe.

channel.wa2coexb4: Ubutumwa {mps} ku isegonda ni bwo ntarengwa
channel.wa2otherd: SIM ya kabiri cyangwa nomero nshya kuri Subiza gusa.
channel.wa2otherg: Byoroshye kurusha ibindi byose ku ruhande rw'ikoranabuhanga
channel.wa2otherb: Ugomba kubwira abakiriya bawe nomero nshya
channel.wa3once: Ibi bikorwa rimwe gusa. Bidatunganye mu gihe cyagenwe, ntibisubirwamo — nomero igomba gukurwaho burundu, hanyuma inzira yose igatangirwa bundi bushya.
channel.wa3title: Icyo ugomba gukora mu masaha {window} ari imbere
channel.wa3k1: Reka WhatsApp Business ifunguye kuri telefone
channel.wa3k1d: Ni yo yohereza amateka. Ifunze, byose birahagarara.
channel.wa3k2d: Uyu munsi, hanyuma nyuma, hanyuma iminsi {history} yose
channel.wa3k3d: Amatsinda, status n'amahamagara ntibiza na gato
channel.wa3rw: Ntabwo tuzi neza niba bihari mu Rwanda
channel.wa3rwd: Meta yashyize Coexistence muri Nigeria na Afurika y'Epfo mu Mata 2026, ikayishyiraho igihugu ku kindi. Nidusanga itaraboneka kuri nomero yawe, tuzabikubwira vuba kandi tugusabe indi nzira.
channel.wa3rwOff: Coexistence ntiri kuri iyi nomero. Tuzakujyana ku zindi nzira ebyiri — ntuzabimenya mu nzira.
channel.wa4title: Ubu Meta ni yo ifata iyi nzira
channel.wa4lede: Idirishya ryabo rirafunguka. Twabanje kuzuza ibyo tuzi kugira ngo ibibazo bibe bike. Dore icyo uzasabwa.
channel.wa4hs: Ntitubona ibiri muri zo, kandi ntidushobora kubihindura
channel.wa4s1: Kwinjira muri Meta no kwemera amasezerano
channel.wa4s3: Konti ya WhatsApp Business, nomero, n'izina rizagaragara — twabizuzuje
channel.wa4s4: Kode ya SMS igera kuri iyo nomero
channel.wa4plat: Ugomba kuba ufite iyo telefone mu ntoki ubu. Ntidushobora kwakira iyo kode mu mwanya wawe, kandi nta n'uwabishobora.
channel.wa4nojs: Idirishya rya Meta risaba umurongo ushobora kurifungura
channel.wa4nojsD: Ibindi byose birakora. Telegram ishobora guhuzwa ubu; WhatsApp itegereza kugeza ufite umurongo ufungura idirishya rya Meta.
channel.wa4expired: Kode y'iyandikisha yarataye igihe nyuma y'amasegonda {ttl}
channel.wa4expiredD: Ntitwigerageza kode yataye igihe. Ongera ufungure idirishya, tuzatangira nshya.
channel.wa5expTitle: Kode y'iyandikisha yarataye igihe nyuma y'amasegonda {ttl}
channel.wa5expBody: Ntitwigerageza iyo kode. Dore isobanuro risobanutse n'uburyo bwo gutangira bundi bushya.
channel.wa5got: Wari ugeze ku {where}. Ni ho abantu benshi bahagarara, akenshi kubera ko SMS itinze kurusha uko byari byitezwe.
channel.wa5h1: Tuzatangira bundi bushya, ariko uzi icyo utegereje
channel.wa5lede: Meta ntiyemera gukomereza aho wagejeje; idirishya ritangirira ku ntangiriro. Icyo dushobora ni ukukubwira aho wari ugeze n'icyakugoye.
channel.wa5prepd: Fata telefone ifite iyo nomero. Kode ya SMS ishobora gufata iminota ibiri. Idirishya ntiryifuza ko usohoka ngo ushakishe.
channel.wa6lede: Ibisigaye biri kuri Meta, kandi ntitwabyihutisha. Dore aho bigeze koko, hamwe n'igihe nyacyo.
channel.wa6queueD: Guhuza WhatsApp nshya bifatanya icyumweru kugeza twemerewe. Iki ni nimero nyayo, si igereranyo.
channel.wa6k2d: Kugeza ryemewe, abakiriya bazabona nomero yawe aho kubona izina. Ubutumwa bukomeza gukora
channel.wa6k3d: Impapuro zawe zoherejwe rimwe gusa, zikoreshwa hose
channel.wa6k4d: Aha ni ho hakunze kugorana muri iki gihugu — reba hasi
channel.wa6okd: Telefone yawe irasubizwa uyu munsi. Telegram irakora. Uzamenyeshwa kuri WhatsApp buri gihe hagize igihinduka — ntukeneye kugaruka hano ureba.
channel.wa7bannerD: Ntabwo bibuza ubutumwa. Abakiriya bakomeza kubona nomero yawe, kandi ubutumwa bukomeza gukora bisanzwe.
channel.wa7lede: Meta yavuze ko izina rifite ibimenyetso n'amagambo yo kwamamaza. Ibi ni byo bakunze kwanga:
channel.wa7g: Amazina rusange nka «Salon» ari yo yonyine
channel.wa7hint: Izina ryanditse muri RDB uko riri ni ryo ryemerwa buri gihe.
channel.wa8lede: Meta yishyuza ubutumwa bumwe na bumwe, kandi yishyuza ubucuruzi ubwabwo, si twe. Ni cyo kibazo gikomeye muri iki gihugu.
channel.wa8tiers: Meta ifite ubwoko bubiri bw'abafatanyabikorwa. Tech Provider ntashobora kwishyura mu mwanya w'abakiriya be — buri bucuruzi bugomba gushyiraho ikarita yabwo. Solution Partner afite umwenda kuri Meta, akayishyura, hanyuma akakwishyuza we ubwe.
channel.wa8momo: Bivuze ko dushobora kwishyura Meta, wowe ukatwishyura na MoMo. Ni yo mpamvu Subiza igomba kubaka hejuru y'umufatanyabikorwa uri kuri urwo rwego — si icyemezo cy'ikoranabuhanga, ni icyo isoko.
channel.wa8nowd: Kugeza tugeze kuri urwo rwego, uzashyiraho uburyo bwo kwishyura muri konti yawe ya Meta. Turakwereka uko bikorwa, kandi ntituzagerageza kubihisha.
channel.wa9lede: Ibi ni ibipimo bya Meta, si ibyacu, kandi bishobora gukorwa bitewe n'imikorere. Kubimenya bikwiye kuruta kubimenya nyuma yo kunanirwa kohereza.
channel.wa9rised: Iyo ubutumwa bwawe bwakiriwe neza kandi ukoresheje nibura kimwe cya kabiri cy'ibyo wemerewe mu cyumweru, Meta ihita yikuza urwego. Ntabwo usaba — birikora.
channel.wa9octd: Kugeza ubu, gusubiza abakiriya ni ubuntu nta ntarengwa. Kuva icyo gihe, uzemererwa {free} ku kwezi kuri buri nomero, hanyuma bikagira igiciro.
channel.wa9ai: Ku byerekeye kubuza AI kuri WhatsApp
channel.wa9aiP: Ushobora kuba warabyumvise: Meta yabujije ubwenge bwa AI busanzwe kuri WhatsApp. Dore uko amasezerano yabo abivuga:
channel.wa9quote: Providers and developers of artificial intelligence… are strictly prohibited from accessing or using the WhatsApp Business Solution… for the purposes of providing, delivering, offering, selling, or otherwise making available such technologies when such technologies are the primary (rather than incidental or ancillary) functionality being made available for use.
channel.wa9ok: Icyabujijwe ni ugukoresha WhatsApp mu gutanga ubwenge bwa AI ubwabwo. Subiza isubiza ibibazo by'isalon yawe: amasaha yawe, ibiciro byawe, gahunda zawe.
channel.ig1title: Konti yawe ya Instagram ni iy'umuntu ku giti cye
channel.ig1lede: Instagram ntiyemera ko porogaramu izo ari zo zose zisoma ubutumwa bwa konti bwite. Guhindukira ni ubuntu, bifata amasegonda make, kandi ushobora gusubira inyuma.
channel.ig1stillD: Si ikosa. Hindura muri Instagram, hanyuma wongere ugenzure.
channel.ig1a: Uko profil yawe igaragara ku bantu
channel.ig1page: Ntabwo bigusaba urupapuro rwa Facebook. Inzira dukoresha ihuza kuri Instagram gusa.
channel.ig2title: Dore ibyo Instagram yemera, n'ibyo itemera
channel.ig2lede: Instagram ifite imipaka ikomeye kurusha WhatsApp, kandi ntawe uyivuga. Ni ngombwa ko uyimenya mbere.
channel.ig2b: Kwishyura kugira ngo urenge iyo mipaka
channel.ig2migd: Ikiganiro kitarangiye kandi amasaha {igWindow} agiye kurangira, Subiza isaba umukiriya kukwandikira kuri WhatsApp cyangwa SMS.
channel.ig2whyd: Kiragura igihe, kandi ikoranabuhanga ryemera ko tugikoresha. Ariko amabwiriza ya Meta avuga ko kigenewe ubutumwa butangwa n'umuntu nyawe. Ubwenge bwa AI ntibukwiye kukoresha, bityo ntitugikoresha.
channel.brkBody: Kuva {since}, ubutumwa bwa {channel} ntibugera kuri Subiza. Telefone n'izindi nzira bikomeza gukora bisanzwe.
channel.brkP: Kuva {since}, ubutumwa bw'abakiriya bwa Instagram ntibugera kuri Subiza. Telefone na WhatsApp bikomeza gukora bisanzwe.
channel.brkLede: Ikimenyetso cyarangije igihe cyacyo. Ibi bibaho buri minsi {tokenDays} iyo kutwongera ubwo burenganzira bidashobotse mbere. Ntacyo wakoze nabi.
channel.brkHint: Meta ntitumenyesha ko uburenganzira bwakuweho. Tubimenya ku butumwa bwa mbere bunaniwe — ni yo mpamvu ubutumwa buvuga igihe twabibonye, aho kwerekana ko twari tubizi mbere.

channelAside.tg1ap: Kugeza vuba, kurema bot byasabaga kuvugana na BotFather ukandukura ikimenyetso. Bot API 9.6 yatanze uburyo bwo gusaba nyir'konti kwemeza, hanyuma tugakura ikimenyetso ubwacu.
channelAside.tg1bp: Nyir'konti agomba gukanda. Nta buryo na bumwe bwo kurema bot mu mwanya w'undi utabizi — kandi ni byo bikwiye.
channelAside.tg2ap: BotFather ni yo nzira y'ubufasha ku verisiyo za kera. Ikimenyetso gishyirwa hano rimwe.
channelAside.tg2bp: Niba ikimenyetso kitari cyo, ubibona kuri iyi paji, si nyuma mu ituze.
channelAside.wa1a: Ikibazo cya kabiri ni cyo cyose
channelAside.wa1ap: Ikosa rikunze kugaragara muri iki cyiciro ni umuntu ufungura idirishya rya Meta, agasanga «nomero isanzwe ikoreshwa», akareka. Kubaza mbere bihindura inzira ipfuye ikaba amahitamo atatu.
channelAside.wa1bp: Utanditse muri RDB, WhatsApp ntizakunda. Ni byiza kubimenya mu masegonda make aho kubimenya nyuma y'iminsi myinshi.
channelAside.wa2ap: Buri nzira ni nziza ku bucuruzi butandukanye. Guhitamo mu mwanya w'umuntu bitera kwicuza — cyane cyane Coexistence, idashobora gusubirwamo.
channelAside.wa2b: Ibibi biri hejuru, si ku mpera
channelAside.wa2bp: Ibigabanya ubushobozi bya Coexistence biragaragara mbere y'ikanda, si nyuma yo kunanirwa. Ni bitanu, kandi byose ni ukuri.
channelAside.wa3ap: Niba ntibitunganye mu gihe, nomero igomba gukurwaho burundu. Ni yo mpamvu imipaka iri kuri iyi paji, mbere y'ikanda.
channelAside.wa3bp: Niba coexistence itari kuri nomero, tubivuga kuri iyi paji tugakujyana ku zindi. Ntuzabimenya mu nzira.
channelAside.wa4ap: Meta ni yo iryubaka. Ariko iratubwira aho umuntu yahagarariye — bityo dushobora kumwakira n'ubufasha bwihariye.
channelAside.wa4bp: Izina ry'ubucuruzi, ubwoko, na nomero byoherezwa mbere. Impapuro nke usabwa kuzuza, ni bike bishobora kunanirwa.
channelAside.wa5ap: Nta mufatanyabikorwa ushobora gukomeza idirishya rya Meta. Duhita dushyira imbaraga ku gutegura: telefone mu ntoki.
channelAside.wa5bp: CANCEL ivuga ipaji. Iryo ni isobanuro, si inshuro yo gukomeza muri Meta.
channelAside.wa6ap: Igihe ni icy'agateganyo kigaragaza urugero rwagutse. Nta buto nyamukuru kuko nta cyo gukora.
channelAside.wa6bp: Ikirango ni ngombwa: telefone irasubizwa uyu munsi, Telegram irakora. Gutegereza hano si gutegereza gutangira ubucuruzi.
channelAside.wa7ap: Ubutumwa bukomeza ku nomero mu gihe izina risuzumwa. Impamvu enye zisanzwe ziri ku paji.
channelAside.wa7bp: Izina ryanditse muri RDB uko riri ni ryo ryemerwa buri gihe.
channelAside.wa8ap: Kugeza Solution Partner yemezwa, ikarita irakenewe kandi ntituzayihisha. Inzira yo gusohoka ni izindi nzira.
channelAside.wa8bp: Umufatanyabikorwa ufite umwenda kuri Meta duhishyura Meta, wowe ukaduha. Icyemezo kiranditswe, nticyahinduwe muri iyi nzira.
channelAside.wa9ap: Ni ibipimo bya Meta, kandi bihinduka. Umuntu umenya urugero rwe kubera ko yanze kohereza, ni twe twamubaye nabi.
channelAside.wa9bp: Abakiriya bawe bazaba barabyumvise. Amasezerano abuza gukoresha WhatsApp mu gutanga AI ubwayo. Ni byiza kubivuga mu magambo ya Meta.
channelAside.ig1ap: Nta porogaramu ihindura konti. «Nahinduye — genzura» isoma Instagram. Gukomeza kuba iy'umuntu ni uko bimeze, si ikosa.
channelAside.ig1bp: API ya Instagram ihuza kuri Instagram gusa. Inzira ya Page yanze.
channelAside.ig2a: Instagram ni yo ikomeye kurusha izindi
channelAside.ig2ap: Nta buryo bwo kwishyura ngo urenge idirishya, kandi igisubizo cyihishe ku gitekerezo ni kimwe burundu.
channelAside.ig2bp: Kugerageza gusubiza igitekerezo ubwa kabiri bitanga ikosa rikomeye. Twandika mbere yo kongera kugerageza.
channelAside.brka: Kuvaho mu ituze ni cyo kibi kurusha ibindi
channelAside.brkap: Meta na Instagram ntibatumenyesha iyo uburenganzira bukuweho. Tubimenya ku butumwa bwa mbere bunaniwe, kandi tugahita tubikubwira.
channelAside.brkbp: Instagram yaracitse; telefone na WhatsApp birakomeza. Iri ni ryo tegeko, kandi rigenzurwa nk'ikizamini.
